notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the standard joined-federate MOM requestObjectInstancesThatCanBeDeleted report. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM interaction and data-element declarations, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, ordinary FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, logical-time configuration when applicable, and application object class and attribute names. It verifies object-class-grouped deletable-object counts before and after ordinary object deletion, reliable RTI-originated report metadata, standard handle/name lookups, nested HLAobjectClassBasedCounts decoding, and cleanup without provider-specific headers, registries, names, diagnostics, periodic timers, or wall-clock assumptions.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador standard MOM deletable-object report request with FederateAmbassador receiveInteraction callback
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador MOM, object-management, declaration, callback, handle-decoding, and standard data-element declarations
